title: 5-Minute Saag Dhal
description: A quick spiced side dish of canned green lentils and spinach stir-fried with garlic, chilli, cumin and turmeric, finished with lemon juice.
ingredients: 400g can green lentils, drained and rinsed
steps: Spray a lidded sauté pan with cooking spray over high heat. Add garlic, chilli, cumin seeds, turmeric, garam masala and salt; stir-fry quickly 30 seconds.
Tip in lentils; stir-fry another 30 seconds; add water.
Keeping heat on high, add spinach; stir-fry 1 minute. Cover; reduce heat slightly; cook 3 minutes.
Give everything a thorough stir; remove from heat; dress with lemon juice and serve.
notes: Swap in garlic paste from a jar, pre-chopped chilli and frozen spinach to make it even quicker.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
